Akra.name: Akra
Akra.description:
A devout follower of her deity and of her society's customs, Akra feels somewhat out of place adventuring in foreign lands. But she feels bound to do everything in her power to bring peace to the region.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Aoth.name: Aoth
Aoth.description:
Aoth lived among animals for so long that he now has difficulty speaking Common. His natural habitat in danger, he decided to join an adventuring group to return balance to his land.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Beiro.name: Beiro
Beiro.description:
Beiro was a famed entertainer at his local tavern, when he one day ran out of stories to tell. To solve this, he set out to make his own stories, so as to one day tell them again at his tavern.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Krusk.name: Krusk
Krusk.description:
Roaming the land brigning justice to all, Krusk has just one goal: the destruction of evil wherever it lies.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Merric.name: Merric
Merric.description:
Merric was once a vigilante, due to her innate sense of street justice. Though her imposing stature makes her a force to be reckoned with in combat, it is her violent outbursts of rage that truly set her apart.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Morthos.name: Morthos
Morthos.description:
Morthos' investigation into her complex draconic-infernal ancestry led her to an academic life, but it soon became apparent that the fools in charge were keeping many secrets from her.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Perrin.name: Perrin
Perrin.description:
A devoted student of his local monastery, Perrin has been tasked with bringing balance to the surrounding lands.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Quillathe.name: Quillathe
Quillathe.description:
Quillathe cleanses monsters from her woods as a hobby, but now a new force menaces her land and she must band with adventurers to defeat it.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Randal.name: Randal
Randal.description:
Randal worked his way through the ranks of his hometown's guard, ultimately growing restless with city life and wandering off in search of adventure.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Riswynn.name: Riswynn
Riswynn.description:
Once a well-respected bureaucrat at the dwarven halls, Riswynn dabbled in intrigue, picked up a few tricks, and ran intro trouble with some nobles. She looks to make a name for herself and regain her social status.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Sefris.name: Sefris
Sefris.description:
Sefris's pickpocketing as a child grew into small burglaries and eventually complex heists, using the dark bond with his fiend to aid his exploits. He'll work for anyone who can throw some coin his way.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Zanna.name: Zanna
Zanna.description:
Always interested in tinkering, Zanna set out for adventure in order to find more spells for her spellbook, and perhaps one day create some of her own.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Overloaded.name: Overloaded
Overloaded.description: The carpet's Fly Speed is halved when carrying more than its normal capacity.

Apparatus of the Crab.name: Apparatus of the Crab
Apparatus of the Crab.description:
To be used as a vehicle, the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgApparatusOfKw]{apparatus} requires one pilot. While the apparatus’s hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 feet. Below that, the vehicle takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage each minute from pressure.

A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus’s levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of the Crab Levers table.

Apparatus of the Crab Levers
LeverUpDown
1Legs extend, allowing the apparatus to walk and swim.Legs retract, reducing the apparatus’s Speed and Swim Speed to 0 and making it unable to benefit from bonuses to speed.
2Forward window shutter opens.Forward window shutter closes.
3Side window shutters open (two per side).Side window shutters close (two per side).
4Two claws extend from the front side of the apparatus.The claws retract.
5Each extended claw makes the following [[/item fmdWz6RQsUCHneZF]]{melee attack}: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.Each extended claw makes the following [[/item tgIjCBtGCZvMu8ij]]{melee attack}: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).
6The apparatus walks or swims forward provided its legs are extended.The apparatus walks or swims backward provided its legs are extended.
7The apparatus turns 90 degrees counterclockwise provided its legs are extended.The apparatus turns 90 degrees clockwise provided its legs are extended.
8Eyelike fixtures emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.The light turns off.
9The apparatus sinks up to 20 feet if it’s in liquid.The apparatus rises up to 20 feet if it’s in liquid.
10The rear hatch unseals and opens.The rear hatch closes and seals.

Lights Activated.name: Lights Activated
Lights Activated.description: Eyelike fixtures emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.
